limitations: Java/Gradle Android builds use bundled JDK21, Gradle9.8, SDK35 and build-tools34. Native npm/Python addons and NDK/C/C++ compilation still require compatible Android payloads; no C/C++ compiler or pip is bundled.
App-data shebang executables cannot run directly. Invoke installed JS/Python entries with bundled node/python3; arbitrary npx CLI execution is not certified.
Git SSH/Perl extensions and ImageMagick external Ghostscript/Graphviz delegates are not bundled.
Runtime ADB requires its own Wireless Debugging pairing. Jev requires a TypeSafe API key.

For APK builds use crew-build <workspace> [Gradle tasks], default assembleDebug. Use bundled gradle rather than executing app-data gradlew. Read CREW_BUILD_RESULT and return its artifact download URL as a clickable Markdown link. Dexdump/split-select legacy inspection commands are unsupported.
